manual.diesel_generator.line2: High-Voltage architecture might be fascinating, but an electrical grid isn't very useful unless there is a generator which can provide for it.{0}
manual.diesel_generator.line3: The Diesel Generator is the primary method of generating HV power. It will run off of {0}Biodiesel{1} or other heavy fuels, as detailed in the following pages. Due to its high output, it will consume fuel rapidly, so sufficient fuel production is a must.{2}
manual.diesel_generator.line4: {0}The engine and generator are constructed from radiators, pipes, engineering blocks, and scaffolding as shown above and formed via activating the central generator with an Engineer's Hammer.{1}
manual.diesel_generator.line5: Fuel is to be input at the bottom corners of the generator, and energy will be output to up to three plugs on the bar above the generator.{0}
manual.diesel_generator.line6: The {0}Flux/t the generator outputs will be split between all connected plugs. The generator will only run when at least one output can accept energy.{1}
manual.diesel_generator.line7: The small terminal on the side will turn off the generator if supplied with a redstone signal, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.{0}
